This is the PDS4 logical identifier for the Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover.
This is the PDS4 logical identifier for them MEDA instrument onboard the Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover.
Reference to the Planet - Mars target

Field_Delimited.name: SCLK
Field_Delimited.description: Spacecraft Clock, as approximated by MEDA internal clock, at the time of the observation, without partition and including decimal thousandths of a second

Field_Delimited.name: SOLAR_LONGITUDE_ANGLE
Field_Delimited.description: Solar azimuth angle relative to M2020 local level frame rotated 180 degrees over the X axis (+X points to the local north direction; +Z points up; +Y completes the right handed frame, pointing to the local west direction; the origin is located between the rover middle wheels and moves with the rover) It is the angle between the positive X-axis and the orthogonal projection of the Sun onto the XY plane. It increases in the counterclockwise sense about the positive Z-axis. Range of -180 to 180 degrees

Field_Delimited.name: SOLAR_ZENITHAL_ANGLE
Field_Delimited.description: Solar elevation angle relative to M2020 local level frame rotated 180 degrees over the X axis (+X points to the local north direction; +Z points up; +Y completes the right handed frame, pointing to the local west direction; the origin is located between the rover middle wheels and moves with the rover) It is the angle between the direction of the Sun and the positive Z-axis. A value of 0 degrees represents Sun at frame zenith, while a value of 180 degrees represents Sun at frame nadir. Range of 0 to 180 degrees.

Field_Delimited.name: ROVER_POSITION_X
Field_Delimited.description: Rover position relative to landing site. It is the X-component of the rover position relative to landing site, expressed with respect to M2020_TOPO frame (+X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the outward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located at the landing site)

Field_Delimited.name: ROVER_POSITION_Y
Field_Delimited.description: Rover position relative to landing site. It is the y-component of the rover position relative to landing site, expressed with respect to M2020_TOPO frame (+X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the outward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located at the landing site)

Field_Delimited.name: ROVER_POSITION_Z
Field_Delimited.description: Rover position relative to landing site. It is the z-component of the rover position relative to landing site, expressed with respect to M2020_TOPO frame (+X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the outward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located at the landing site)

Field_Delimited.name: ROVER_PITCH
Field_Delimited.description: Rover pitch, or counterclockwise rotation angle about the +Y-axis of the M2020_LOCAL_LEVEL frame. M2020_LOCAL_LEVEL frame is defined as follows: +X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the downward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located between the rover middle wheels and moves with the rover

Field_Delimited.name: ROVER_YAW
Field_Delimited.description: Rover yaw, or counterclockwise rotation angle about the +Z-axis of the M2020_LOCAL_LEVEL frame. M2020_LOCAL_LEVEL frame is defined as follows: +X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the downward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located between the rover middle wheels and moves with the rover

Field_Delimited.name: ROVER_ROLL
Field_Delimited.description: Rover roll, or counterclockwise rotation angle about the +X-axis of the M2020_LOCAL_LEVEL frame. M2020_LOCAL_LEVEL frame is defined as follows: +X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the downward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located between the rover middle wheels and moves with the rover

Field_Delimited.name: MASTHEAD_AZIMUTH
Field_Delimited.description: Masthead azimuth angle. Range of -180 to 180 degrees. An azimuth angle of 1 degree represents rover looking backward, an azimuth angle of 91 degrees represents rover looking to the left, an azimuth angle of -179 degrees represents rover looking forward, and an azimuth angle of -89 degrees represents rover looking to the right

Field_Delimited.name: MASTHEAD_ELEVATION
Field_Delimited.description: Masthead elevation angle. Range of 0 to 360 degrees. An elevation angle of 1 degree represents rover looking down, an elevation angle of 91 degrees represents rover looking forward and an elevation angle of 181 degrees represents rover looking at the zenith
